namePrompt.title: Choose your display name
namePrompt.intro: This name will appear under your comments and reactions. The name on your {provider} account is never published, it is only a starting suggestion.
namePrompt.label: Display name
namePrompt.hint: Between 2 and 32 characters. You can change it at any time from your account.

account.title: My account
account.intro: What this site knows about you, and what you can do about it.
account.signedOutBody: Sign in from the footer of any article to reach this page. For any other request about your data, write to the address listed in the legal notice.
account.profileIntro: The name below is the only part of your account other readers can see.
account.dataIntro: Here is everything that is kept about you.

dataItems.identity: The name your provider returns, kept for moderation and never published.
dataItems.displayName: The display name you chose, publicly visible.
dataItems.email: The address on your {provider} account, never published and never used to write to you.
dataItems.avatar: The address of your profile picture at your provider.
dataItems.account: Your account id at that provider, used to recognise you on your next sign-in.
dataItems.content: Your comments and reactions, with their dates.

account.downloadHint: A readable file containing your record, your comments and your reactions.
account.deleteBody: Your account, your name, your address and your reactions are erased immediately and permanently. Your comments stay online, signed “Deleted account”, so the discussions other people took part in are not left full of holes.
account.deleteConfirmLabel: To confirm, type your display name
account.deletedBody: Your record, your address and your reactions have been erased. Your comments stay online, signed “Deleted account”.
